title: Runtime Phenomenon Space and Existing-System Decomposition
results: Process is a realization substrate/view rather than a safe foundation root.
State-transition models are necessary representational grammar but insufficient Runtime definitions.
Broad runtime ancestry is provisionally selected/specifiable behavior -> realization -> lifecycle/observation.
Ordivon Runtime is provisionally a durable authority-bounded realization-and-convergence specialization for Agent-selected operations.
Intentional/specification, ontic/realization, and epistemic/evidence planes must not collapse.
Time/order, termination/finality, failure, and recovery are multidimensional.
Recovery is not retry; effect semantics must justify new dispatch.
Effect is world/projection-relative and cannot be inferred generically from arbitrary process evidence.
Current Job/Attempt/Evidence/Reconciliation distinctions receive foundation-level support.
Workspace, finite Jobs, and Agent Effect Commit Kernel remain specializations to be re-tested.

nextRound.title: State, Change, Event, Transition, Behavior and Dynamics
nextRound.entryQuestion: What lower structure of state/change/behavior must exist before action, execution and Runtime realization can be defined without circularity?

notes: RF0 is foundation research. It does not authorize Runtime Core refactoring or public Tool changes.
